drivingQuestion: Whose view in the mishna's dispute over the latest time for the evening Shema does the halakha follow?
outcomeNote: The halakha is decided in accordance with Rabban Gamliel.

segments.he: רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר וְכוּ׳: אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה, אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: הֲלָכָה כְּרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל.
segments.en: The Gemara returns to explain the mishna, in which we learned that «Rabban Gamliel says:» One may recite Shema until dawn. «Rav Yehuda said» that «Shmuel said: The halakha is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabban Gamliel.»

moves.summary: the mishna's lemma: Rabban Gamliel says the evening Shema may be recited until dawn
moves.about: the mishna's clause that Rabban Gamliel permits the evening Shema until dawn

moves.cueHe: אמר רב יהודה, אמר שמואל: הלכה כרבן גמליאל
moves.summary: Shmuel (via Rav Yehuda) rules that the halakha follows Rabban Gamliel
moves.about: the latest time for the evening Shema is dawn
